limits: Single returned grid cell; not a North East regional or station-grade series.
Hourly outdoor reanalysis, not instantaneous design extremes or indoor observations.
No year repeated, no gap filled, no climate values clipped; downstream indoor projections remain synthetic.
NASA sensitivity is only 2023 and is not used to fill the primary 2023-2024 series.
Historical terms snapshot retained; underlying C3S reuse and NASA licence text remain legally unverified; owner approval is synthetic-demo-only.
Source API does not expose an exact ERA5 revision or server build; repeat requests may differ, so use committed byte hashes.
The default Open-Meteo elevation/cell selection was retained; returned elevation is 65 m, unlike the prior candidate request (98 m).
